import type { TranscriptionTranscript } from "vite-hub/agent/capabilities"
import { renderTemplate } from "#vitehub/templates"
import {
  advanceAgentStage,
  completeAgentRun,
} from "../../databases/jobs"
import { outputLanguages, requireGatewayCredential } from "../../databases/settings"
import { generateGatewayObject } from "../../providers/gateway"

export interface SummaryOutput {
  summary: string
  title: string
  translation: string
}

export interface SummaryRunContext {
  attemptNonce: string
  jobId: string
  modelId: string
  outputLanguage: string
  sourceKey: string
  userId: string
}

export interface RunSummaryInput extends SummaryRunContext {
  transcript: string
}

export async function runSummaryAgent(input: RunSummaryInput): Promise<void> {
  const credential = await requireGatewayCredential(input.userId)
  const language = outputLanguages.find(option => option.code === input.outputLanguage)?.label
  if (!language) throw new Error("The job has an unsupported output language.")
  const system = await renderTemplate("summary", { OUTPUT_LANGUAGE: language })

  const { translation } = await generateGatewayObject({
    apiKey: credential.apiKey,
    model: input.modelId,
    prompt: input.transcript,
    schema: {
      additionalProperties: false,
      properties: { translation: { minLength: 1, type: "string" } },
      required: ["translation"],
      type: "object",
    },
    schemaName: "recording_translation",
    system: `${system}\n\nPerform only the translation task and return the structured translation result.`,
    validate(value) {
      const result = asRecord(value)
      if (typeof result.translation !== "string" || !result.translation.trim())
        throw new Error("Translation is missing.")
      return { translation: result.translation }
    },
  })
  await advanceAgentStage(input.jobId, input.attemptNonce, "summarize")

  const result = await generateGatewayObject({
    apiKey: credential.apiKey,
    model: input.modelId,
    prompt: translation,
    schema: {
      additionalProperties: false,
      properties: {
        summary: { minLength: 1, type: "string" },
        title: { minLength: 1, type: "string" },
      },
      required: ["title", "summary"],
      type: "object",
    },
    schemaName: "recording_summary",
    system: `${system}\n\nPerform only the summary and title task and return the structured summary result.`,
    validate(value) {
      const output = asRecord(value)
      if (typeof output.title !== "string" || !output.title.trim())
        throw new Error("Title is missing.")
      if (typeof output.summary !== "string" || !output.summary.trim())
        throw new Error("Summary is missing.")
      return { summary: output.summary, title: output.title }
    },
  })
  await advanceAgentStage(input.jobId, input.attemptNonce, "finalize")
  await completeAgentRun({
    attemptNonce: input.attemptNonce,
    jobId: input.jobId,
    output: { ...result, translation },
    sourceKey: input.sourceKey,
    userId: input.userId,
  })
}

export function formatTranscript(transcript: TranscriptionTranscript): string {
  const words = transcript.words || []
  const header = [
    "# Transcript",
    transcript.language
      ? `Detected language: ${transcript.language.toUpperCase()}${typeof transcript.languageConfidence === "number" ? ` (${Math.round(transcript.languageConfidence * 100)}% confidence)` : ""}`
      : undefined,
  ].filter(Boolean).join("\n\n")

  if (!words.length) return `${header}\n\n${transcript.text.trim()}\n`

  const turns: Array<{ speaker: string, start: number, text: string }> = []
  for (const word of words) {
    const speaker = word.speaker || (word.channel === undefined ? "Speaker" : `Channel ${word.channel + 1}`)
    let turn = turns.at(-1)
    if (!turn || turn.speaker !== speaker) {
      turn = { speaker, start: word.start || 0, text: "" }
      turns.push(turn)
    }
    turn.text += word.text
  }

  const body = turns
    .map(turn => `**${speakerLabel(turn.speaker)}** · ${timestamp(turn.start)}\n\n${turn.text.trim()}`)
    .join("\n\n")
  return `${header}\n\n${body}\n`
}

function speakerLabel(value: string): string {
  const match = value.match(/^speaker_(\d+)$/i)
  return match ? `Speaker ${Number(match[1]) + 1}` : value
}

function timestamp(seconds: number): string {
  const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor(seconds))
  const hours = Math.floor(total / 3600)
  const minutes = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60)
  const remainder = total % 60
  return hours
    ? `${hours}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(remainder).padStart(2, "0")}`
    : `${minutes}:${String(remainder).padStart(2, "0")}`
}

function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value))
    throw new Error("Structured result must be an object.")
  return value as Record<string, unknown>
}
